''See also: [[Hound Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Hounds]] serve as the [[First Division]] under [[Makiel]] and are represented by a blue, three-headed dog symbol. As a division, they possess the specialized ability to observe and influence [[Fate]], allowing talented members to glimpse the destinies of various [[Iterations]]. They can identify where different fates overlap and investigate potential violations, though their foresight is limited to a thirty-year window within [[Cradle]]. Their power allows them to manipulate chance and bend [[Fate]], which can increase the likelihood of a [[Dreadgod]] noticing certain events. While they are currently stretched thin due to an ongoing war, they provide reports and simulations regarding the stability and future of different worlds. [[Makiel]] is a prominent figure within the [[Hounds]], described as a [[Judge]] with the [[Authority|authority]] to direct other [[Judges]] and steer causality to avoid chaos or nonexistence. [[Makiel]] is depicted as a rat-like man with dark, beady eyes and a thin beard, often appearing in white armor. Despite his appearance, he possesses immense power, including the ability to manifest a broad two-handed [[sword]] and command the disappearance of powerful weapons. He has also demonstrated the [[Authority|authority]] to revoke the ability of others to view or manipulate [[Fate]], imposing strict restrictions on their sight and access to certain tools.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Hound]] is a messenger that possesses a rat-like face. This entity wears full battle armor consisting of white plating.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As a role within the [[Abidan]], [[The Hound|the Hound]] possesses observational Authority{{!}}authority and directs the [[Judges]]. This entity acts as a guide for [[Fate]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] possesses the vision of [[The Hound|the Hound]]. [[The Hound]] also maintains [[Authority|authority]] over the [[Judges]], whom it directs.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The will of [[The Hound|the Hound]] is capable of bending [[Fate]]. Additionally, their specific techniques allow for the acquisition of several extra senses.}}
